# skills.md — UC-X Ask My Documents
# Generated by prompting an AI assistant, then manually refined. Delete the template comment before committing.

skills:
  - name: retrieve_documents
    description: Loads the three CMC policy files and indexes every numbered clause with its document name, section number, heading and text.
    input: Path to data/policy-documents/ containing policy_hr_leave.txt, policy_it_acceptable_use.txt, policy_finance_reimbursement.txt.
    output: List of clause dicts {doc, section, heading, text, tokens} plus an idf map over clause tokens (rare words weigh more).
    error_handling: Refuses to start (exit non-zero) if any of the three expected policy files is missing — answers would be incomplete.

  - name: answer_question
    description: Returns a single-source, cited answer built from clause text, or the exact refusal template when the question is not covered or two documents tie.
    input: A question string, the clause index, and the idf map.
    output: "Source: <doc> — section <nums>" followed by the quoted clause(s), or the refusal template verbatim.
    error_handling: Refuses (template) when fewer than 2 distinct non-generic question terms match the best clause, when no clause scores, or when a clause from another document scores within 90% of the best; asserts no hedging phrase appears in a built answer.
